about_short_description.short_description: Jify is building employee financial wellness via earned salary access and better money management tools.

product.name: On-Demand Salary (Earned Wage Access)
product.description: Allows employees to access a portion of their earned salary before payday, interest-free, to manage financial needs flexibly.

product.name: Jify Salary and Benefits Card
product.description: A prepaid card linked to on-demand salary access, enabling employees to spend their earned wages with cashback and rewards.

product.name: Money Manager
product.description: A financial wellness tool offering budgeting, expense tracking, financial coaching, and literacy resources to employees.

product.name: Digital Gold Investment Facilitation (via Augmont)
product.description: A platform feature enabling employees to buy, sell, and hold digital gold and silver through Jify’s app, facilitated by Augmont.
